examples.title: Example 1: Setting onAccessibilityActionIntercept to Intercept Click Events
examples.description: The example demonstrates how to use the onAccessibilityActionIntercept event to intercept a click event on a Toggle component in accessibility mode before the click event is processed.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the onAccessibilityFocus Callback
examples.description: Since API version 18, this callback is triggered when the focus status changes. This example demonstrates the basic usage of onAccessibilityFocus. When the focus is on onAccessibilityFocus takes effect, [testingTag] isFocus current is true is logged. When the focus is on any other area, [testingTag] isFocus current is false is logged.
